component.name: ChatGPT Desktop (Unofficial)
component.summary: Unofficial Linux desktop shell for ChatGPT

description.p: ChatGPT Desktop wraps the ChatGPT web app in a Linux-focused Electron shell with saved settings, tray integration when supported by the session, keyboard-driven navigation, and user customization hooks.
This build is unofficial, is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, and keeps its config, data, and cache inside sandbox-managed XDG directories while using desktop portals for host integrations.
